dataset_name: Tweets of Popular South African Banks
github_repo_licence: MIT (applies to software/code in the repository)
kaggle_dataset_licence: Kaggle dataset licence requires independent confirmation before publication
twitter_content_note: Twitter/X content redistribution is governed by the Twitter/X Terms of Service and Developer Agreement. The MIT licence on the collection code does not resolve tweet-content reuse obligations. This must be assessed independently before publication.

study_date_range_used.rationale: 2018–2022 selected for contemporary digital banking relevance, stronger coverage of mobile/online banking, and manageable scope. This is a study-scope decision, not a data-quality filtering decision.

region_provenance_basis: All five tracked institutions (FNB, Absa, Nedbank, Capitec, Standard Bank) are South African retail banks. The dataset was constructed to collect SA banking Twitter content. Bank column contains only SA bank identifiers. Region is not inferred from bank names alone — it is confirmed by the dataset's scope.
raw_text_rationale: The Tweet column contains raw collected tweet text as returned by the Twitter API. No pre-cleaned text column exists. The Tweet field is the authoritative source text.
tweet_id_handling: Hashed into record_id (sha256); raw Tweet_Id not stored in canonical output
